main_review_notes: The local commit23268953 is fork-specific: the moe-decode-cpu report source link Niko1221/Strata/tree/23268953 should be yqYo1/Strata/tree/23268953314d12588fd3f496414a46bd426a7306. Original researcher report preserved.
Use prefill-code-audit-addendum over the initial prefill report for active MMQ/fused status and B70/AMD measurement attribution.
Existing layer-major, cache release, MTP suspension, CPU grouping and AVX2 multi-token are not new implementation proposals.
External hardware figures are not B570 forecasts. Approximate missing-expert masking from B70 is outside exact-output tuning.

The Intel transfer report states up to4 workers; actual default on this12-logical-CPU machine is3 (hardware_concurrency/4), and previous passive observation showed all3 inheriting hostCPU0. The affinity candidate requests CPU1,2,3 without changing worker count.

The existing xmx_gemm_iq has no production prefill call path. docs/INTEL.md historical 4-5x slowdown refers to Arc Pro B70/Coder IQ1_M, not a B570 result. New integration must have a specific hypothesis beyond enabling existing code.

USM prepare/release APIs forbid overlapping live ranges. Declared/exported symbols and success without exception do not establish actual host-memory import; matching installed v2 runtime implementation and real import/release support remain unqualified. Existing SYCL PinnedArena registration is a no-op.

A source lifetime-safe import requires the final DMA consumer completion, exact base/context release, and release before arena retirement. Stager::finish only joins CPU staging jobs and is not DMA completion. Current quiet measurements do not enable import.
Current resident ArenaExpertSource does not benefit from the file-backed prefetch ordering candidate; that conditional suggestion is not scheduled for this RAM-resident baseline.

Correction to decode-weight-reuse-round2.txt wording: 70 output tok/s means 14.2857ms per output token; with m output tokens per verification window, target window time is m*14.2857ms. Aggregated expert timing is not serial critical-path time.
